language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface language. Messages and server names stay as written.

ui.grytIsEmptyUntilYouJoinAServer: Gryt is empty until you join a server. Add a friend's with an invite, or start one of your own.
ui.alsoInYourListUnderAnotherAddress: Also in your list under another address
ui.iMReallyGladYouReHereAnd: I'm really glad you're here, and that you decided to give it a go. It's all built by me, a senior product engineer from Norway 🇳🇴
ui.itSJustMeKeepingItRunningSo: It's just me keeping it running, so some things are still a bit rough around the edges. If something breaks, please tell me. There's a Give feedback button in settings.
ui.ifYouReReadyIDBeHappy: If you're ready, I'd be happy to show you around. Enjoy Gryt! 😊
ui.alreadyUseGrytOnAnotherDevice: Already use Gryt on another device?
ui.nothingMatchesTryTheNameOfTheControl: Nothing matches. Try the name of the control, or a word from its description.
ui.usedOnServersYouJoinFromNowOn: Used on servers you join from now on. Use Sync to apply it to servers you are already on.
ui.shownUnderYourNameOnEveryServerYou: Shown under your name on every server you are on. Leave it empty for nothing.
ui.thatVideoCanTBePlayedHere: That video can't be played here
ui.thisServerDoesNotLetYouUploadA: This server does not let you upload a picture. Designing an owl still works.
ui.noneOfTheseServersLetYouUploadA: None of these servers let you upload a picture. Designing an owl still works.
ui.thisServerDoesnTTakeVideoAvatarsPick: This server doesn't take video avatars. Pick a picture instead.
ui.noneOfTheseServersTakeVideoAvatarsPick: None of these servers take video avatars. Pick a picture instead.
ui.yourVideoIsUploadedItShowsOnYour: Your video is uploaded. It shows on your card once the server has converted it.
ui.thatServerIsTheOnlyOneYouRe: That server is the only one you're on, so there's nowhere to copy it to.
ui.nothingToCopyThisServerHasNoAvatar: Nothing to copy: this server has no avatar of its own yet.
ui.twoWaysToShowItGamesThatReport: Two ways to show it: games that report it themselves, and programs you add by hand.
ui.yourNameOnEachServerStaysAsIt: Your name on each server stays as it is.
ui.noneOfYourServersLetYouUploadA: None of your servers let you upload a picture. Designing an owl still works.
ui.itRunsOnThisMachineAndYourFriends: It runs on this machine, and your friends connect to you.
ui.pasteTheInviteAFriendSentYouOr: Paste the invite a friend sent you, or the address of a server you already know.
ui.pasteAnInviteOrEnterTheHttpsAddress: Paste an invite, or enter the HTTPS address of a server you already know.
ui.startOneOfYourOwnOrJoinSomebody: Start one of your own, or join somebody else's.
ui.runsOnThisMachineBestForAFew: Runs on this machine. Best for a few friends.
ui.pasteALinkOrAnAddressYouWere: Paste a link or an address you were given.
ui.askedSomebodyWhoRunsThisServerHasTo: Asked. Somebody who runs this server has to let you in. It is in your server list now, marked as waiting, and opens on its own once they do. You can close this.
ui.publicInfoIsOffAnInviteCodeCan: Public info is off. An invite code can still get you in.
ui.voiceActivityTransmitsWheneverYouSpeakAb: Voice activity transmits whenever you speak above the noise gate. Push to talk only transmits while you hold a key, and hides the gate below.
ui.microphoneIsInitializingAudioLevelsAndNo: Microphone is initializing. Audio levels and noise gate will be visible once ready.
ui.speaker: Speaker
ui.yourMicrophoneInputLevel100Unchanged2002: Your microphone input level (100% = unchanged, 200% = 2x boost)
ui.audioBelowThisLevelWillBeMutedThe: Audio below this level will be muted. The indicator shows your raw microphone input level.
ui.howLongTheGateStaysOpenAfterYour: How long the gate stays open after your voice drops below the threshold.
ui.hearYourselfThroughYourSpeakersOrHeadpho: Hear yourself through your speakers or headphones, to check what the processing is doing.
ui.removesBackgroundNoiseBeforeYourVoiceIsS: Removes background noise before your voice is sent. Runs in an AudioWorklet off the main thread, and adds about 20 ms.
ui.bringsYourMicrophoneToATargetVolumeQuiet: Brings your microphone to a target volume. Quiet speech is boosted, loud speech is reduced.
ui.theVolumeYourVoiceIsBroughtToLower: The volume your voice is brought to. Lower is quieter, higher is louder.
ui.narrowsTheGapBetweenYourQuietestAndLoude: Narrows the gap between your quietest and loudest, so your level stays steadier. Runs after auto gain.
ui.howAggressivelyToCompressLowSubtleLeveli: How aggressively to compress. Low = subtle leveling, high = heavy squash.
ui.warnMeWhenMyMicrophoneGoesSilent: Warn me when my microphone goes silent
ui.saysSoIfYourMicrophoneStopsSendingAnythi: Says so if your microphone stops sending anything at all while you are in a voice channel. Some headsets mute their own noise floor between sentences, which looks the same from here, so turn this off if it keeps firing while you are audible.
ui.volumeOfAllIncomingAudio100Unchanged200: Volume of all incoming audio (100% = unchanged, 200% = 2x boost)
ui.nativeAudioCaptureIsActiveGrytVoicesAre: Native audio capture is active — Gryt voices are excluded at the OS level.
ui.bindAKeyOrTheMiddleOrA: Bind a key, or the middle or a side mouse button. In the desktop app they work while Gryt is in the background. Press Escape to cancel binding.
ui.holdThisKeyOrMouseButtonToTransmit: Hold this key or mouse button to transmit your microphone.
ui.toggleYourMicrophoneOnOrOff: Toggle your microphone on or off.
ui.muteAllIncomingAudioAndYourMicrophone: Mute all incoming audio and your microphone.
ui.disconnectFromTheCurrentVoiceChannel: Disconnect from the current voice channel.
ui.pushToTalkIsOnButNothingIs: Push to talk is on, but nothing is bound to it yet. Press a key, or the middle or a side mouse button.
ui.pressSomethingElseToChangeItOrConfirm: Press something else to change it, or confirm below.
ui.blursProfaneWordsWhenTheServerHasProfani: Blurs profane words when the server has profanity filtering set to flag. Click a blurred word to reveal it.
ui.playersFromYoutubeSpotifyTwitchAndTheLik: Players from YouTube, Spotify, Twitch and the like, pictures and videos linked from other sites, and the pictures on link previews all load from those sites, which can see that you opened them. Off, players and files wait for you to press Load, and previews show text only.
ui.sitesYouChoseToAlwaysLoadFrom: Sites you chose to always load from:
ui.ctrlPlusCtrlMinusToZoomCtrl0: Ctrl+Plus / Ctrl+Minus to zoom, Ctrl+0 to reset
ui.setTheIdentityServiceTooYourAuthServer: Set the identity service too. Your auth server needs the one that signs for it, or signing in is rejected.
ui.usingYourOwnAuthServerSignInTo: Using your own auth server. Sign in to check it works.
ui.backToTheGrytAuthServer: Back to the Gryt auth server.
ui.serversYouJoinedBeforeSigningInCameWith: Servers you joined before signing in came with you — your roles and anything you own moved to this account the next time you connected.
ui.theseOpenAuthGrytChatAndBringYou: These open auth.gryt.chat and bring you back when you are done.
ui.permanentAndItCannotBeUndoneItRemoves: Permanent, and it cannot be undone. It removes your Gryt account. Messages you sent live on the servers that received them, and deleting this does not reach them.
ui.grytWorksWithoutAnAccountWhatOneAdds: Gryt works without an account. What one adds is a way back in: an identity that survives losing this device, and the same you on every server rather than a separate one each time.
ui.signingInKeepsTheServersYouHaveAlready: Signing in keeps the servers you have already joined. They move to your account the next time you connect to each one.
ui.signInWithYourOwnAuth: Sign in with your own auth
ui.signedInOnAnotherDeviceOrUsingGryt: Signed in on another device, or using Gryt there as a guest? Link this one and it gets the same identity and servers.
ui.whereAccountsComeFromLeaveThisAloneUnles: Where accounts come from. Leave this alone unless you run your own Keycloak — the address of its realm, not the server root.
ui.andTheIdentityServiceThatSignsCertificat: And the identity service that signs certificates for it. It is a separate service, so it cannot be worked out from the address above.
ui.aServerAlsoHasToTrustCertificatesFrom: A server also has to trust certificates from your identity service, or it will refuse the join.
ui.yourRecoveryKeyIsTheIdentityYouUse: Your recovery key is the identity you use on servers you join without an account. It is one key for every server, and it is the only copy: nothing on our side can bring it back.
ui.ifYouLoseThisDeviceOrClearIts: If you lose this device or clear its data without saving your recovery key, you lose the roles, ownership and history attached to every server you joined without an account. Keep it in a password manager or somewhere else safe.
ui.these24WordsCanRestoreYourIdentityAnyone: These 24 words can restore your identity. Anyone who has them can use it, so keep them like a password.
ui.pasteYour24WordRecoveryKeyGrytWill: Paste your 24-word recovery key. Gryt will replace the local identity on this device and reload.
ui.haveAnOlderGrytBackupFile: Have an older Gryt backup file?
ui.enterThePasswordForThisOlderBackupFile: Enter the password for this older backup file.
ui.youNeedAGrytAccountToJoinSign: You need a Gryt account to join. Sign in and you'll come back to this invite.
ui.askedSomebodyWhoRunsThisServerHasToLet: Asked. Somebody who runs this server has to let you in. It's in your server list now, marked as waiting, and opens on its own once they do.
ui.signInAgainToReconnectToThisServer: Sign in again to reconnect to this server.
ui.youReBeingRateLimitedPleaseWaitA: You're being rate limited. Please wait a moment and try again.
ui.anErrorOccurredWhileLoadingServerDetails: An error occurred while loading server details.
ui.lostConnectionToTheServerAttemptingToRec: Lost connection to the server. Attempting to reconnect automatically.
ui.thisServerCouldNotProveItIsThe: This server could not prove it is the one you joined before.
ui.unableToEstablishAConnectionTheServerMay: Unable to establish a connection. The server may be offline or there could be a network issue.
ui.theServerIsTakingAWhileToRespond: The server is taking a while to respond. This could be due to network conditions or the server being under load.
ui.youVeBeenDisconnectedBecauseYouJoinedFro: You've been disconnected because you joined from another device.
ui.onlyOneDeviceCanBeConnectedToVoice: Only one device can be connected to voice at a time. You can rejoin from any device.
ui.youDoNotHavePermissionToAttachFiles: You do not have permission to attach files here.
ui.thisDeletesTheMessageForEveryoneYouCan: This deletes the message for everyone. You can't undo it.
ui.everyoneWhoCanReadThisChannel: Everyone who can read this channel
ui.textChatIsNotAvailableInThisVoice: Text chat is not available in this voice channel
ui.thisChannelIsNotReadableWithYourRole: This channel is not readable with your role.
ui.textChatIsDisabledInThisVoiceChannel: Text chat is disabled in this voice channel
ui.whoeverRunsThisServerCanReadWhatYou: Whoever runs this server can read what you send here, in the clear.
ui.thisIsAnAutomatedChannelMdashMessagesCom: This is an automated channel — messages come from bots and the system. You can read here, but not post.
ui.youCannotJoinThisVoiceChannel: You cannot join this voice channel.
ui.channelMentionCopiedPasteItIntoAnyMessag: Channel mention copied. Paste it into any message.
ui.youCanTShareVideoInThisChannel: You can't share video in this channel any more, so your camera is off.
ui.youCanTShareYourScreenInThis: You can't share your screen in this channel any more, so the share stopped.
ui.youCanTSpeakInThisChannelAny: You can't speak in this channel any more, so you're muted.
ui.youAreServerMutedByAnAdmin: You are server muted by an admin.
ui.youAreServerDeafenedByAnAdmin: You are server deafened by an admin.
ui.chooseWhichAppsYouReSharingAudioFrom: Choose which apps you're sharing audio from
ui.youCanHearOthersButTheyCannotHear: — you can hear others, but they cannot hear you.
ui.yourMicrophoneIsNotPickingUpAnySound: Your microphone is not picking up any sound — others cannot hear you. Check the selected device, and that it is not muted.
ui.youReTheOnlyOneHereEndingThe: You're the only one here. Ending the call in
ui.lowestPossibleLatencyDisablesAllAudioPro: Lowest possible latency. Disables all audio processing, enables push-to-talk, caps bitrate at 128kbps (studio quality), and optimizes Opus packetization (10ms frames).
ui.youAreMarkedAfkAfterThisManyMinutes: You are marked AFK after this many minutes of silence, and only while you are connected to voice.
ui.playSoundWhenConnectingToVoice: Play sound when connecting to voice
ui.playSoundWhenDisconnectingFromVoice: Play sound when disconnecting from voice
ui.howTheVoiceGridArrangesPeopleOnceIt: How the voice grid arranges people once it is maximised or fullscreen. Both were measured against Google Meet; which you prefer is a matter of taste. The sidebar looks the same either way.
ui.withExactlyTwoOfYouInAChannel: With exactly two of you in a channel and nobody sharing a screen. One large and one small is what a video call usually does; same size is better when you are both doing something rather than talking to each other.

chat.readOnly: You can read here, but not post.
chat.longPaste: That's too long to paste. Messages can be up to {{count}} characters, and you can't attach files here.
chat.deleteThread: This deletes the message and the {{count}} replies in its thread. You can't undo it.

audio.rnnoiseActive: RNNoise is active — background noise will be filtered
audio.autoGainActive: Auto gain is active — your voice will be normalized to the target level
audio.compressorActive: Compressor is active — dynamic peaks will be tamed
audio.micFailed: Your microphone could not be started
audio.esportsActive: Active — RNNoise off, noise gate bypassed, PTT enabled, 128kbps cap, ptime=10ms

invite.member: You're already a member of this server.
invite.invited: You've been invited to join this server. No password required.
invite.needsCode: This server needs an invite code.
invite.request: Somebody who runs this server has to let you in.
invite.private: This server doesn't share its details. You can still try to join.

errors.timeout: No response from this server. It may be advertising an address it is not reachable on.
errors.inviteRequired: This server is invite-only. Paste an invite code to join.
errors.accountRequired: This server requires a Gryt account. Sign in from the menu at the bottom left, then try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
errors.connect: Could not connect to the server. Check the address and your network.
errors.joinTimeout: Connection timed out. The server may be down or unreachable.
errors.permission: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.webHttps: The web client can only connect to servers over HTTPS. Use a domain with TLS, or use localhost on this machine.

profile.avatarRemove: Your avatar will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
profile.avatarRemoveServer: Your avatar will be removed from {{server}}. This action cannot be undone.
profile.scopedName: This is how other people on {{server}} see you.

server.leaveDescription: You stop being a member of {{server}}. Your messages stay and keep your name on them, but your picture there is deleted, and if the server is invite-only you will need a new invite to come back.
server.removeDescription: {{server}} goes from your sidebar. You are still a member, so you keep your roles and anything you own there. You just will not be connected: nobody sees you online, and changing your picture will not change it there.

launch.accounts-down: Can't reach Gryt accounts right now. You can keep using Gryt without signing in.
launch.offline: You're offline, so Gryt can't check your account. It'll open without signing you in.
launch.slow: This is taking longer than it should. Gryt will carry on without an account in a moment.
launch.browser: You're using Gryt in your browser. Some features are limited.

terms.title: Before you post
terms.agreement: Please agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <guidelines>Community Guidelines</guidelines>.
terms.conduct: Abusive content and abusive people aren’t tolerated. You can report both, and block anyone who bothers you.
